page.layout: Two printed pages on one scan: the left page shows a narrow strip of text at the far left edge (partly cut), the right page carries the main text block with marginal notes on its left side and a running head at the top. Right page: running head line, then main text in one column with notes in the left margin.; One block of text in the centre-right with marginal notes in the right margin (set beside the lines), and a few partial marginal fragments at the far left edge outside the text block; the text continues to the lower part of the page.

main_text.l: In CRETA fuit adhuc Minos, cujus uxor
Pasiphae, quia occasiones adulterii ex labyrintho
fumpsit, ideò Dædalus in carcerem conjectus
est, ex quo elapsus, in Siciliam ad Cocalum per-
venit.
In PHRYGIA Priamus jussit Argonautas,
de quibus mox, finibus suis excedere. Illi vi-
m fecere, & Hesione soror ejus pellex Telamonis fa-
cta est.
Apud LYDOS coepisse Heraclidarum hoc
tempore familia dicitur. Stirps ipsorum Laome-
don seu Alcaeus, Herculis ex Omphale, Atyada
Sardis regnantium familiæ, filius. Ab eo
ad Ardysum, qui in tempora Ulsiæ Azariæ incidit,
octodecim Reges numerantur, ex quibus Argos
seu Meles Sardes Regnum transtulit, & Leo F.
dentium os continuum habuit. Reliqui igno-
rantur. Caeterum inter Attyadas fuit & Camble-
tes, qui uxorem suam dilaniavit & comedit; re
vulgatâ, se ipsum jugulavit; & Adramytes, qu-
i primus omnium mulieres fecit Eunuchas, eisque
vice Eunuchorum usus est.

page.notes: The left page is cut off and only fragments of its text remain at the left edge, so it is not transcribed. Marginal notes are partly illegible in the scan. Marginal fragments at the far left edge (partial words such as "ejus", "vit", "la") are cut and only partly legible, so they are omitted. Numbers in the left margin are partly cut off and uncertain. The continuation of the line "Phe-" with "F" beneath is a lower fragment of the scan.
